create_RetrievalVis: create a RetrievalVis instance to set up an HTML visualization directory with video symlinks
visualize_ranking: call visualize_ranking to generate an HTML page showing top-k retrieval results for a given epoch
display_current_results: call display_current_results to render rankings with R1/R5/R10/MedR metrics into an HTML webpage
mkdirs: call mkdirs to create multiple directories from a list of paths if they do not exist
mkdir: call mkdir to create a single directory if it does not already exist
